svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Encoder vs decoder vs sparse attention is entirely a question of which squares are filled in
A filled square means that query is allowed to look at that key. That is the only difference between the families.
Causal masking is one line of code: set future scores to minus infinity before the softmax.
